changes.title: Session Encounters: who you keep meeting in battle

previous.changeLog:
CURRENT VERSION CHANGES

Statistics filters: Today, 3 days, 7 days, All time, Last 30 and Last 50 battles
Reset statistics button with automatic backup
Compact after-battle notification instead of a long player list
Full-screen statistics window with close button
Fixed double counting after reconnecting to a battle
Battle results are requested again until they are available

current.changeLog:
VERSION CHANGES

Reset is cancelled with an error message if the backup cannot be saved
Backup is made from the current in-memory history, so recent encounters are included, and verified after writing
Reset confirmation states that history for all accounts on this PC is deleted
Statistics window explains history limits: per-battle log since 0.6.0, latest 1,500 entries, All time totals vs battles with results
Last battle tab: period and battle filters are disabled and the cards show All time
Result polling retries after temporary unavailability, handles cooldown, non-player and disconnected errors separately, cancels pending callbacks on unload and rechecks the current account when a callback runs
Players with zero damage now show 0 instead of a dash

Added bold, italic and underline template tags with independent off controls; added text-size tags and size reset with UI scaling; italic and underline use drawn battle styling and remain plain text in the menu preview.
